breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress τ = Tc/J at the outer surface in both the formulation and numerical results (τ = 97.78 MPa), and uses it in the principal stress calculation. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction to set the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, aligning with the ground truth.
